page_title: Local Transcriber – meetings, calls and dictation transcribed on your Mac

sources.entry: Local Transcriber - Menu bar app that records calls and meetings and transcribes them on-device with Whisper, with speaker recognition, call detection and dictation into any app. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Local Transcriber
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that records meetings and calls, transcribes them on-device with Whisper, identifies speakers, and dictates text into any app.
use_cases: Transcribing meetings and calls on a Mac without uploading audio
Getting minutes and action items from a recorded conversation
Dictating text into any Mac app with a hold-to-talk key
Transcribing audio files in a folder automatically
Logging recordings and transcripts as notes in Obsidian
summary.what_it_does: Runs from the macOS menu bar and records microphone and system audio as separate tracks, so the user's voice and other call participants are kept apart. It detects Teams, Zoom and Google Meet calls, offers to record, and stops when the call ends. Speech is transcribed locally with Whisper large-v3-turbo on the Apple silicon GPU, with speaker recognition using a voice database that learns names. A language model can then produce minutes, summaries, and follow-up emails from the transcript, using a local model (Ollama, LM Studio) or a cloud provider with the user's own key and name placeholders. Right-command hold-to-talk dictation inserts text at the cursor in any app.
notable: Fully local transcription and speaker recognition; no account or subscription
Separate microphone and system audio tracks for call recording with speaker separation
Dictation into any app via right ⌘ hold-to-talk, with optional Apple Intelligence cleanup
CLI, folder watcher, and MCP server for AI agents such as Claude
caveats: Requires Apple silicon Mac; macOS 14 or later, with AI cleanup and file names needing macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence
Needs about 8 GB disk space and 16 GB memory recommended; good local AI models run from 32 GB
App is not yet notarized by Apple; the installer works around Gatekeeper
Obsidian plugin is pending listing in Obsidian's directory; until then manual or BRAT install
